interpretation: User requests project knowledge and future prevention; positive overall feedback on the repaired set. Not independent, per-language native-speaker, or lossless-background acceptance.
review_failure: Existing written requirements and a passing same-Agent review did not prevent residual anti-aliased source letters, erroneous moving button bounds, or insufficient typography fit. Technical record validity cannot establish visual observation quality.
confirmed_source_specific_causes: White CTA cleanup missed gray and anti-aliased source-letter edges; repaired full interior based on source blank surface.

At frames 246-248 the white-outline detector absorbed the adjacent watch contour and caused black spill outside the rounded button. Repair used the actual black interior and restored original source pixels outside it.
Target letter height, center, style, and frame-dependent scale needed source measurements; source-specific fonts and coordinates are not universal defaults.
During repair, background yellow target text covered the foreground button at frames 209-210; final layer order clips it behind the button.
Poster exit opacity needed the actual source transition rather than a fixed target-text rectangle.

comparison.layout: Left old held Spanish output; right repaired Spanish output. Top moving CTA frame 247; bottom poster CTA frame 360. This is selected local evidence, not whole-video verification.

review_scope: This knowledge curation re-read records and inspected selected actual old/new output comparison. It did not re-review every frame or rerun video production.
procedure_change: Require source appearance contract and per-instance observations with actual hashes, four-layer evidence, full dynamic-region frame coverage and explicit pending states. Agent procedure; no new machine visual evaluator.
limits: Single-source repair. Four languages are derivatives of the same master, not four independent algorithm validations. Original non-CTA approximations and earlier holds remain.
